scorer_kind: per-arm unique modal plus a between-arm contrast
argument: the D2/D3 failure mode required a branch that sets the sample size from the noise result; this gate has none, so the pair cannot conflict mathematically
contrast_with_the_retired_d2_pattern: D2 had '5 -> r = 14' paired with a unanimity scorer, where buying trials raised the bar; here buying trials is not expressible

budget_derivation.derived_from: the frozen scorer's shape, not from any previous line's budget
budget_derivation.step_1: the criterion is a per-arm unique modal plus a between-arm contrast, so the target needs BOTH arms measured
budget_derivation.step_2: therefore target total = 2r, with r replicates per arm; r is not the total
budget_derivation.step_3: r = 6 per arm, because at r = 6 the criterion tolerates up to TWO deviating trials without losing modal uniqueness (6-0, 5-1 and 4-2 all leave a unique modal; only 3-3 ties)
budget_derivation.step_4: no r-extension branch exists, so the derivation stops at the smallest r that keeps the modal unique under a two-trial deviation
budget_derivation.budget_note: 27 is a CONSEQUENCE of the frozen scorer, the frozen qualification rule and the frozen gate shape; it was not assumed and then justified
